Messages.Author: BearofMilwaukee
Messages.Body:
Further, if the card is molotov cocktail, can he strike with it every
round?

Messages.Author: quetzalcoatl
Messages.Body:
BearofMilwaukee wrote:
> Further, if the card is molotov cocktail, can he strike with it every
> round?

Personally I would say he could (since he is "playing it") from your
hand, however he needs to be able to press to second round to actually
use the damage of it.

However I'm more inclined to think that the minute he uses it (first
time), it becomes an enquipment card which is burnt after combat ends
or it is used and thus the Satyr is left without an abiilty.
